goal: Go to the Enchanted Forest north of the village to meet the owl, then find the first dungeon.

leads.claim: Island is named Cocolint

leads.quote: Suis la route du Sud, vers la plage
leads.claim: Follow the south road toward the beach where she found Link

leads.quote: des monstres terribles rôdent dans le coin
leads.claim: Dangerous monsters roam nearby
The shield is returned and repels enemies

leads.quote: Y'a un autre bidule qui est resté sur la plage
leads.claim: Another item (probably the sword) was left on the beach
Monsters are everywhere outside

leads.quote: Pour sauvegarder, appuyez sur tous les boutons à la fois
leads.claim: To save, press all buttons at once (A, B, START, SELECT)

leads.quote: Après une sauvegarde, vous pouvez redémarrer à la dernière porte par laquelle vous êtes passé!
leads.claim: After saving, you restart at the last door you passed through

leads.quote: Consultez la carte de l'île en appuyant sur SELECT.
leads.claim: Press SELECT to view the island map

leads.quote: Si vos Coeurs diminuent trop, entrez dans une maison ou une grotte.
leads.claim: When hearts get low, enter a house or cave to recover
Cave Flagello is a nearby location, signposted
Coco Beach is in the direction down on the sign

leads.quote: Tu n'y arriveras jamais rien que par la force de tes bras!
leads.claim: The heavy object cannot be moved by arm strength alone; another item is needed.
Flavour text about a pet dog proud of its fur
The Animal Village lies further east, past the prairie
Use the shield to protect against the sea urchins (oursins)

leads.quote: Viens me voir dans la Forêt
leads.claim: The owl asks Link to meet him in the Enchanted Forest, north of the village
Link must wake the Wind Fish to leave the island

leads.quote: as-tu visité la Cave Flagello, située au Sud du village?
leads.claim: Visit Cave Flagello south of the village

leads.quote: Vas-y avec la Clé cachée dans la Forêt.
leads.claim: A key is hidden in the Forest; needed for Cave Flagello
The NPC is a mischievous raccoon; small talk only.
Someone taunts that Link will get lost in the Forest; the forest is a maze
Monique's house is nearby along this path
Bobo Pond is in this direction
